info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Zeolite Jacket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Zeolite Jacket Catalog Management API allows users to add detailed information about zeolite jackets to the product catalog. This functionality enables businesses to effectively manage the specifications, materials, and features of their zeolite jacket offerings. Typically utilized by inventory managers and product developers, this API streamlines the process of enhancing product visibility and ensuring accurate descriptions in the catalog. By providing a robust interface for adding jacket details, businesses can improve their product presentation and enhance customer satisfaction.
